versions.grouping_at_time: Weight Range and Center of Gravity
versions.text:
The empty weight and corresponding center of gravity location shall

include all fixed ballast, the unusable fuel supply (see § 3.437), undrainable oil, full engine coolant, and hydraulic fluid. The weight and location of items of equipment installed when the airplane is weighed shall be noted in the Airplane Flight Manual.
